name: Pick up an object from the floor
short_description: Pick up an object from the floor once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can pick up an object from the floor in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Pick up an object from the floor means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Pick up an object from the floor in a fresh real-life scenario.
